root_cause_summary: Heuristically generated from MUMmer alignment against truncated local FASTA (4,492,785 bp vs expected 4,687,476 bp). Emitted 4 false MOB and 7 false JC across unaligned tail.
Inferred IS1 and IS10 transpositions from MUMmer DUP lengths within truncated tail; false positive chromosomal insertions.
Seven false breakpoint junctions derived from truncated contig boundary and repeat segments within unaligned tail.
MUMmer rdiff diff records produced because local SY22A1.fna omitted the terminal 194,691 bp of the chromosome.
dnadiff report reflecting 95.85% alignment coverage due to 194,691 bp missing contig tail.
MUMmer nucmer delta alignment file for truncated contig.
